message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case: development and sale of game cheat/外挂 software for profit. The prosecution claims illegal经营 (illegal business) i.e., illegal经营罪. In Chinese criminal law, selling cheat software may be considered "非法经营罪" (illegal business) under article 225? Actually article 225 is "非法经营罪" for illegal business activities that disrupt market order, e.g., selling pirated software, counterfeit goods, etc. Also could be "侵犯著作权罪" (copyright infringement) but they are selling a program that modifies game, maybe considered "侵犯著作权罪" (software copyright infringement) under article 217. However the prosecution says illegal经营罪. The typical classification for selling game cheat is "非法经营罪" (illegal business) because it disrupts market order. Also could be "侵犯著作权罪" if they copy the game code, but they wrote separate program. The cheat program may be considered a derivative work, but not necessarily infringing if they didn't copy code. The main crime is illegal经营. So answer: [罪名]非法经营<eoa>.
